# Reveal File in Finder

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Reveals the given file in finder.

## Syntax

~~~~text
revealFile(file: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
revealFile(file: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
